notes.title: Ib Japanese Remake Version released on April 11th
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

We are pleased to announce that Ib, a 2D exploration adventure horror game set in a art gallery, has released today, April 11th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42028463/a27284b564508280297c4dc72878ae68e5052830.png[/img]

The Steam Trading Card function is supported for this Steam release. Please enjoy playing and collect the cards!

To celebrate the release, we are also running a campaign where you can win a framed illustration of Ib so please do join us!

[url=https://twitter.com/playismJP/status/1513426948772757506]https://twitter.com/playismJP/status/1513426948772757506[/url]

For bug reports, please fill in on Steam Community Discussion threads.

Now as the Japanese version has been released, we have already started working on localising Ib into other languages. We are now preparing so that all players overseas can play it as soon as possible so please bear with us a bit longer.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1901370/Ib/

notes.title: Ib Store Page Reveal. Planned for 2022 release.
notes.notes:
Dear fans,

February 27th 2022 marks the 10 year anniversary of Ib, a 2D horror adventure game set in a creepy art gallery. The Steam store page for the remake version is now live.
Virtually all of the graphics have been updated for this remake version, with many upgraded and additional effects as well.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1901370/Ib/

Release is planned for sometime in 2022, please add the title to your wishlists while you wait for release.

[h2]Comment from developer, kouri[/h2]
Sorry it’s taking so long to release, please wait a little while longer!
While I was making this remake, I was thinking how it would be nice to release it with official translations and now it is actually happening!
Once the Japanese version is released the localization process is set to begin and I will personally be overseeing the process too. I ask for your patience while we complete the translations.
